scientific_goal: Rank rice breeding lines by expected 100-grain weight and, within a phenotyping budget, identify lines that are likely in the high-yield quartile.
input_entity: rice line genotype (2000 pruned SNP dosages) and line identifier
applicability: indica/japonica diversity panel represented in the Orhobor et al. 2018 dataset
known_limits: linear model ignores epistasis and non-additive effects
predicted values are E1 model predictions, not measured phenotypes
cannot rank lines outside the reference panel or with unseen markers
uncertainty_sources: environmental variance not captured by genotype
historical_measurement: real measured GRWT100 per line from the source dataset; exposed only through the hidden evidence oracle (E3)
